theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [CommGroup G] [Group.FG G] (hG : IsMulTorsion G) : Finite G := by
  have h_free_rank_zero : CommGroup.freeRank G = 0 :=
    (CommGroup.freeRank_eq_zero_iff _).mp hG
    
  have h_finite : Finite G :=
    by
      rw [CommGroup.freeRank_eq_zero_iff]
      exact (Group.fg_of_finite G).mp h_free_rank_zero
    
  exact h_finite
